caption: The drawing depicts a single urn-shaped vessel positioned centrally on a plain beige background. The vessel is outlined in thin black lines and features subtle shading, especially around the top decorative border. The top portion of the vessel is adorned with a stylized grayish-blue ornamental design, which includes two symmetrically placed loop handles at either side near the rim. Near the upper center of the vessel, inside the ornamental band, there is text that reads "COROLIUS MANHATTAN WELL NEW YORK." The remainder of the vessel is unadorned and colorless, with the rest of the sheet being blank except for some faint handwriting and numbering near the bottom edge.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
